data.body: [operator-attested] Evidence for c11-373f748a: this criterion includes continuity of older checked-out workflows and environments, which lives outside the current snapshot. Gerrit change 1553 merged only after LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, zero unresolved comments, and CI run 31283137439 passed 15/15 jobs across Python 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS. Post-merge compatibility proof passed 47/47 focused tests: legacy CLI retains dry-run default; direct-engine legacy invocation retains live default; legacy `--filter-local-ids` retains post-differ write filtering; library and MCP reconcile remain registered; every workflow rollback and exit mapping remains pinned. The old adapter paths remain present at `src/rebar/_cli/__init__.py`, `src/rebar/_lib_ops.py`, `src/rebar/_mcp_reads.py`, and `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/request.py`. Therefore older workflow revisions and environments using `reconcile`, `--mode`, or `--filter-local-ids` retain their prior functional path.
